# qualcomm — 2015 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 180 qualcomm CVEs of 2015 are in `data/cve/vendors/qualcomm/2015.jsonl`.

### CVE-2015-9222
- Assigner: qualcomm | Published: 2018-04-18 | Updated: 2024-09-17 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop') in Video.
- Exploit-DB 39739: RomPager 4.34 (Multiple Router Vendors) - 'Misfortune Cookie' Authentication Bypass (webapps/hardware, 2016-04-27, verified=0)

In Android before 2018-04-05 or earlier security patch level on Qualcomm Snapdragon Mobile and Snapdragon Wear MSM8909W, SD 210/SD 212/SD 205, SD 400, SD 410/12, SD 425, SD 427, SD 430, SD 435, SD 450, SD 625, SD 650/52, SD 800, SD 808, SD 810, SD 820, SD 835, SD 845, SDM630, SDM636, SDM660, and Snapdragon_High_Med_2016, processing erroneous bitstreams may result in a HW freeze. FW should detect the HW freeze based on watchdog timer, but because the watchdog timer is not enabled, an infinite loop occurs, resulting in a device freeze.

Affected:
- Qualcomm, Inc. / Snapdragon Mobile, Snapdragon Wear: affected MSM8909W, SD 210/SD 212/SD 205, SD 400, SD 410/12, SD 425, SD 427, SD 430, SD 435, SD 450, SD 625, SD 650/52, SD 800, SD 808, SD 810, SD 820, SD 835, SD 845, SDM630, SDM636, SDM660, Snapdragon_High_Med_2016
